tooltip.utilitymachines.drill.1: Right-click a minecart to install it.
tooltip.utilitymachines.drill.2: Sneak + right-click with empty hand: toggle on/off.
tooltip.utilitymachines.drill.3: With a chest minecart: stores mined items and stops when full. Lays rails automatically.
message.utilitymachines.drill_already: This minecart already has a drill
message.utilitymachines.drill_need_rail: The minecart must be on a rail
message.utilitymachines.drill_need_strai: Place it on a straight rail
message.utilitymachines.drill_no_floor: Drill stopped: no floor for the rail
tooltip.utilitymachines.key_hint: Hold it to open whatever its padlock closes.
tooltip.utilitymachines.key_hint2: Sneak + click: removes the padlock. Can be renamed in an anvil.
tooltip.utilitymachines.padlock_hint: Hold in main hand and right-click a door or chest.
tooltip.utilitymachines.padlock_strength: Strength: maximum, unbreakable without the key
message.utilitymachines.lock_unbreakable: The padlock is unbreakable without its key
tooltip.utilitymachines.master_key: Opens any padlock except netherite ones
tooltip.utilitymachines.lockpick: Picks a padlock: it stays open for 10 seconds.
tooltip.utilitymachines.lockpick2: Chance depends on the material. If it fails, the owner is alerted.
tooltip.utilitymachines.ring_hint: Key in the other hand + click: store · Sneak + click: take out
message.utilitymachines.pick_fail: The pick slips... you made noise!
message.utilitymachines.alarm: Someone is picking one of your padlocks at %s, %s, %s!
message.utilitymachines.ring_dup: That key is already on the keyring
message.utilitymachines.ring_took: You took a key off the keyring
